destination.name: Inverell
destination.tagline: The 'Sapphire City' on the Macintyre River, with a big lake and a pioneer village.
destination.description: Inverell is a town of 12,057 people (2021 census) on the Macintyre River close to the Queensland border, known as the Sapphire City for its mining of sapphires, tin and zircon. Nearby Copeton Dam supplies its water and is a popular water sports lake. Inside town are the Inverell Art Gallery and the Pioneer Village, and the Myall Creek Massacre Memorial near Bingara marks an 1838 massacre.
whyVisit: Fish and boat on Lake Copeton
Walk the Myall Creek memorial boulders

goodToKnow.title: Copeton fees
goodToKnow.detail: A day pass costs about $15 to $17.50, and park access runs 5:00 AM to 9:30 PM (office 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM).

goodToKnow.title: Myall Creek is unstaffed
goodToKnow.detail: The memorial walk is open daily, has no staff, and is near Bingara, not in Inverell.

goodToKnow.title: Visitor centre
goodToKnow.detail: The tourist information centre in the Campbell Street coach terminal opens Monday to Friday 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM and weekends 9:00 AM to 2:00 PM (Wikivoyage, 2019).

destination.bestTimeBlurb: Come in {months}: spring and autumn have mild days for the lake and the memorial walk, before the summer heat.
